pairing-qr-pick.title: Choose pairings
pairing-qr-pick.short: Ticks a pairing to include its label.

pairing-qr-generate.short: Makes the label PDF and downloads it.

advisor-screen.short: Suggests pairings from your Breeders group toward a goal you type, ranked by the estimated chance of reaching it.
advisor-screen.more: The advisor only looks at males and females in the Breeders group, and only at those that carry a gene from your goal. Every percentage is an estimate worked out from the genetics recorded on your animals, not a promise. Nothing it shows changes your records.
tips: Check the genetics of your breeders first. The suggestions are only as good as what is recorded.

advisor-goal.short: Describes the animal you want to produce, in plain words, such as clown desert ghost with pastel.
advisor-goal.more: Morph names and their aliases are picked out of the text, so commas are not needed.

advisor-status.short: Says what the advisor is doing and how many suggestions reached the confidence bar of 60 percent.

advisor-run.short: Works out which of your breeder pairs give the best estimated chance of your goal, and lists them as suggestions.
advisor-run.more: It uses the genetics recorded on your animals. The advisor is also built to ask a web search service for demand and price signals, using the morph names of each pair. No search service is set up in this app, so normally no search is made and the cards show no demand signals or price guidance.

advisor-reset.short: Clears the goal, the suggestions, the ignored suggestions and the plan settings. Your animals and pairings are not touched.

advisor-export.short: Downloads a CSV file of your existing pairings, grouped by male.
advisor-export.more: It lists pairings you already have, not the advisor's suggestions.

advisor-card.title: Suggested pairing
advisor-card.short: Shows one suggested pair with its estimated chance of producing your goal per hatchling.
advisor-card.more: The percentage is an estimate, not a promise. Green cards meet the confidence bar of 60 percent; the others are listed as worth reviewing. The gene rows show the goal genes, the projected outcomes and any holdbacks.

advisor-accept.short: Has no effect yet. Pressing it does not save, mark or hide the suggestion.
advisor-accept.more: To act on a suggestion, use Make a plan.

advisor-make-plan.short: Opens the Create pairing window with this male and female, today's date and a note with the estimated goal chance.
advisor-make-plan.more: Nothing is created until you press New pairing in that window.

advisor-show-plan.short: Opens a breeding plan flowchart for this pair, showing how the goal could be reached over several generations.

advisor-ignore.short: Hides this suggestion until the next run or a reset.

advisor-multi-gen.title: Multi-generation plan
advisor-multi-gen.short: Shows or hides the steps toward the goal: each generation's pair, its estimated chances and the holdbacks to keep.
advisor-multi-gen.more: Direct means the goal can come from this pair. 2-step means a holdback from this pair is bred on. The combined figure is the estimated chance over all the steps.

advisor-progress.short: Shows the advisor's steps while it works, and a summary when it is done.
advisor-progress.more: Close only hides this window; the run carries on.

advisor-progress-retry.short: Runs the advisor again with the same goal.

advisor-progress-results.short: Closes this window to show the suggestions.

advisor-plan-dialog.short: Draws a multi-generation breeding plan for one suggestion as a flowchart, with the estimated chance at each step.
advisor-plan-dialog.more: The plan is not saved. It is redrawn each time you open it.

advisor-plan-threshold.short: The estimated chance, from 1 to 100 percent, at which the plan counts the goal as reached. It starts at 70.

advisor-plan-generations.short: How many generations the plan may use, from 1 to 8. It starts at 5.

advisor-plan-update.short: Redraws the plan with the threshold and generation limit you set.

advisor-plan-chart.title: Breeding flowchart
advisor-plan-chart.short: Shows the plan's pairings, outcomes and holdbacks as boxes. Press a box to see its details below the chart.
advisor-plan-chart.more: Use the buttons in the corner to zoom and fit the chart.

tree-screen.short: Draws the pedigree of the selected animal: its parents, ancestors, clutch mates and offspring.
tree-screen.more: The tree is built from the parents set in each animal's record and from the clutches and hatchlings on your pairings. When the shared pedigree service can be reached it may add relatives; if it cannot, a note says so and your own records are still shown.

tree-view-tree.short: Shows ancestors, clutch mates and offspring around the selected animal.

tree-view-horizontal.short: Shows a pedigree chart in the printed style, read from left to right.

tree-view-lineage.short: Shows ancestors and descendants together, scrolling both ways.

tree-view-clutch.short: Shows each clutch whole: the parents, the hatchlings and the eggs not hatched yet.

tree-view-universe.short: Shows the whole collection as one connected graph.

tree-canvas.title: Pedigree chart
tree-canvas.short: Draws the pedigree in the view you chose. Drag to move around and use the corner buttons to zoom.
tree-canvas.more: If nothing is drawn, set the parents in the animal's record or log a clutch on its pairing.

tree-node.title: Animal card
tree-node.short: Shows one animal in the tree. Press it to centre the tree on that animal.
tree-node.more: The colour says how it is related to the selected animal; see the Legend. Eggs that have not hatched are drawn as outlines and cannot be selected.

tree-clutch-node.short: Labels a clutch on the tree with its clutch ID and how many hatched or are still in the egg.

tree-unknown-parent.title: Unknown parent
tree-unknown-parent.short: Marks a parent that is not on record.
tree-unknown-parent.more: Set the sire or dam in the animal's record to fill it in.

tree-selected.title: Selected animal
tree-selected.short: Shows the animal the tree is centred on, with its genetics, hatch date, breeder, ID and parents.

tree-switch-snake.short: Picks another animal to centre the tree on.

tree-legend.short: Explains the colours and lines: selected animal, sire, dam, clutch sibling, offspring, unknown parent, and confirmed or unconfirmed links.

tree-passport.short: Sums up the selected animal's pedigree: parents, offspring, clutches and ownership records.

tree-passport-overview.short: Shows counts of parents, offspring, clutches and owners, with the genetics, parents, clutch IDs and offspring.

tree-passport-history.short: Shows the ownership history of the animal, when the shared pedigree service has records for it.

tree-passport-health.short: Is not available yet. The tab only says that health records and tests are coming.

tree-passport-files.short: Is not available yet. The tab only says that files and documents are coming.

tree-stats.title: Snakes, Clutches, Breeders, Bloodlines, Generations
tree-stats.short: Counts what the tree shows: animals, clutches, breeders, bloodlines and generations.
tree-stats.more: This collection means the figures come from your own records. Shared pedigree means the shared pedigree service answered.

concept-clutch.title: Clutch
concept-clutch.short: A clutch is the eggs one female lays from one pairing. In Serpentora it is recorded on the pairing, not as a record of its own.
concept-clutch.more: The laying date, fertile eggs, slugs, egg boxes, bad eggs and the hatch are all kept on the pairing card. Each clutch gets a number, a Clutch ID made from the parents and the season, and one or two egg boxes in the Incubator. Hatchlings created from it are linked back to the pairing, which is how the Family Tree finds them.
concept-clutch.words: clutch eggs laid egg box hatch

spaces-screen.short: Maps where your animals live: rooms, the racks and terrariums in each room, and which animal sits in which tub.
spaces-screen.more: Spaces covers the whole collection, whatever the species. Start with a room, open it, then add racks and terrariums to it. Each rack tub and each terrarium place holds one animal. Spaces only records where you say an animal is. It cannot see the real enclosure, so keep it in step when you move an animal.
tips: When an animal is in quarantine, Serpentora adds a room called Quarantine here if you do not have one yet.
spaces-screen.words: rooms racks tubs terrariums enclosures housing locations where

spaces-room-name.short: Types the name of the new room before you add it.

spaces-add-room.short: Adds an empty room with the name you typed.
spaces-add-room.more: The button stays grey until the name box has text. The new room appears as a card at the end of the list. Open it to add racks and terrariums.
spaces-add-room.words: new room create room add room

spaces-room-card.title: Room card
spaces-room-card.short: Shows one room with how many racks and terrariums it holds. Press the card to open the room.
spaces-room-card.more: Rename and Delete on the card act on this room. Open room does the same as pressing the card.

spaces-room-open.short: Opens the room window, where you add, edit and open its racks and terrariums.

spaces-room-rename.short: Asks for a new name for this room and saves it.
spaces-room-rename.more: Cancel or an empty name keeps the old name.

spaces-room-delete.short: Deletes this room after you confirm, together with every rack and terrarium in it.
spaces-room-delete.more: The animals themselves are not deleted. They simply no longer have a place in Spaces. A deleted room cannot be brought back from here. If any animal is in quarantine and you delete the Quarantine room, Serpentora adds an empty Quarantine room again.

spaces-service-last.short: Marks the Quarantine room, as a reminder to look after it after the rest of the collection.
spaces-service-last.more: Serpentora adds this room by itself when an animal is in quarantine. The badge is a reminder only. Nothing is blocked.

spaces-room-window.title: Room window
spaces-room-window.short: Shows one room with its racks on one side and its terrariums on the other.
spaces-room-window.more: From here you add racks and terrariums, open them, edit or delete them, and rename, move or delete the room itself.

spaces-room-move.title: Move up, Move down
spaces-room-move.short: Moves this room one place earlier or later in the list of rooms.
spaces-room-move.more: The order is only how the rooms are listed. A button is greyed out when the room is already first or last.

spaces-room-close.short: Closes the room window. Nothing is lost; changes are already saved.

spaces-add-rack.short: Opens the rack form to add a new rack to this room.

spaces-add-terrarium.short: Opens the terrarium form to add a new terrarium to this room.
spaces-add-terrarium.words: new terrarium create terrarium vivarium enclosure

spaces-rack-card.title: Rack card
spaces-rack-card.short: Shows one rack with its layout and how many tubs are in use. Press the card to open the rack.
spaces-rack-card.more: Layout is columns by levels. Usage is filled tubs out of all tubs.

spaces-terrarium-card.title: Terrarium card
spaces-terrarium-card.short: Shows one terrarium with its size and how many animals are inside. Press the card to open it.

spaces-rack-edit.short: Opens the rack form to change this rack's name, tub size or layout.
spaces-rack-edit.more: If you make a rack smaller, check which animals sat in the tubs that go away.

spaces-rack-delete.short: Deletes this rack straight away, with every tub assignment in it.
spaces-rack-delete.more: There is no confirmation and no undo. The animals are not deleted; they just lose their tub in Spaces.

spaces-terrarium-edit.short: Opens the terrarium form to change this terrarium's name, size or number of animals.

spaces-terrarium-delete.short: Deletes this terrarium straight away, with the list of animals inside it.
spaces-terrarium-delete.more: There is no confirmation and no undo. The animals are not deleted; they just lose their place in Spaces.

spaces-form-cancel.short: Closes the form without saving anything.

spaces-window-close.short: Closes this window. Assignments you made are already saved.

rack-form.short: Sets up a rack: its name, its tub size and how many columns and levels of tubs it has. The same form edits an existing rack.
rack-form.more: The total number of tubs is columns times levels, and the form shows it before you save. Each tub holds one animal. When editing, the title reads Edit rack.
rack-form.words: rack setup create rack edit rack

rack-name.short: Names the rack, so you can tell it apart from others in the room. A name is required.

rack-tub-size.short: Picks the tub size from the list, or Custom to type your own label and measurements.

rack-columns.short: Sets how many columns of tubs the rack has. Each column is a vertical line of tubs.

rack-levels.short: Sets how many levels, or shelves, the rack has, counted from the top.

rack-custom-tub.short: Names your own tub size and gives its width, depth and height with a unit. Shown only when the tub size is Custom.
rack-custom-tub.more: With Custom, the label and all three measurements are needed before the form can be saved.
rack-custom-tub.words: custom tub dimensions width depth height unit

rack-form-save.short: Saves the rack. When adding a new rack this button reads Add Rack.
rack-form-save.more: It stays grey until the rack has a name, and a label and measurements when the tub size is Custom.

terrarium-form.short: Sets up a terrarium: its name, its size and how many animals it holds. The same form edits an existing terrarium.
terrarium-form.more: Name, width, depth and height are all needed before you can save. When editing, the title reads Edit terrarium.
terrarium-form.words: terrarium setup create terrarium edit terrarium

terrarium-name.short: Names the terrarium. A name is required.

terrarium-dimensions.title: Width, Depth, Height
terrarium-dimensions.short: Records the terrarium's inside size and the unit: cm, mm or in. All three numbers are required.
terrarium-dimensions.words: size dimensions width depth height unit

terrarium-capacity.short: Sets how many animals this terrarium can hold. Each animal gets its own place.
terrarium-capacity.more: When the terrarium is full, no more animals can be assigned to it.

terrarium-form-save.short: Saves the terrarium. When adding a new terrarium this button reads Add Terrarium.

rack-view.title: Rack window
rack-view.short: Shows the rack as a grid of tubs, level by level, with the animal in each one.
rack-view.more: Press any tub to put an animal in it, swap the animal or empty it. Edit and Delete at the top act on the whole rack.

rack-slot.short: Opens the assign window for this tub, to put an animal in it, change it or empty it.
rack-slot.more: A filled tub shows the animal's name and ID. Each tub shows its number and its place as level and column.

rack-assign.title: Assign tub
rack-assign.short: Chooses which animal sits in this tub, from a list, by search or with a QR scan.
rack-assign.more: An animal can sit in only one rack tub. Choosing an animal that is already in another rack tub moves it here and empties the old tub. Animals in other rack tubs are left out of the list.
rack-assign.words: assign tub place animal move animal

rack-assign-search.short: Narrows the list to animals whose name or ID contains what you type.

rack-assign-pick.title: Animal in the list
rack-assign-pick.short: Puts this animal in the tub and closes the window.
rack-assign-pick.more: The animal already in this tub is marked Currently assigned.

rack-assign-scanner.title: QR scanner
rack-assign-scanner.short: Lets a handheld QR scanner fill this tub: scan the animal's label while this window is open.
rack-assign-scanner.more: The scanned ID must match an animal in your collection. If it does not, the window says so and nothing changes.

rack-assign-empty.short: Empties this tub, so no animal is recorded in it.
rack-assign-empty.more: The animal is not deleted. It just has no tub in this rack any more.

terrarium-view.title: Terrarium window
terrarium-view.short: Shows the animals in this terrarium and lets you add or take them out.
terrarium-view.more: The count shows how many places are filled out of the number of animals the terrarium holds. Edit and Delete at the top act on the whole terrarium.

terrarium-occupant-remove.title: x
terrarium-occupant-remove.short: Takes this animal out of the terrarium straight away.
terrarium-occupant-remove.more: There is no confirmation, but you can add the animal again with Assign snake.

terrarium-choose.short: Picks the animal to add. Animals already in this terrarium are left out.
terrarium-choose.more: The list is greyed out when the terrarium is full.

terrarium-assign.short: Adds the chosen animal to this terrarium.
terrarium-assign.more: It stays grey until you choose an animal and there is a free place.

feed-prep-window.short: Builds a defrost list for feeding day: tick the animals to feed, and Serpentora adds up the feeders you need, grouped by type and size.
feed-prep-window.more: Each animal's feeder comes from its feeder profile: food type, size or weight class, and how many. Animals without a food type and a size or weight are listed but left out of the totals. Females with ovulation recorded in an active pairing, and no clutch yet, are left out and cannot be ticked.
tips: The window opens with every animal that can be fed already ticked.
feed-prep-window.words: feeding defrost thaw feeders rodents prey shopping list

feed-prep-select-all.short: Ticks every animal that can be fed. Excluded females stay unticked.

feed-prep-clear.short: Unticks every animal, so you can tick only the ones you feed today.

feed-prep-copy.short: Copies the defrost report as plain text, one line per feeder group, ready to paste anywhere.
feed-prep-copy.more: The button reads Copied for a moment when it worked. It is grey when the report is empty.

feed-prep-close.short: Closes Feed Prep. Your ticks are not kept; the next time it opens with every animal ticked again.

feed-prep-totals.title: Totals
feed-prep-totals.short: Counts the ticked animals, those with and without feeder data, the feeders to defrost and the females left out for ovulation.

feed-prep-report.short: Lists what to take out of the freezer, grouped by food type, size or weight class, and weight, with how many of each.
feed-prep-report.more: Only ticked animals with a complete feeder profile count here.

feed-prep-selection.short: Lists every animal with its feeder, so you can tick the ones to feed.
feed-prep-selection.more: Under each name you see its feeder, Missing feeder data, or why it is left out.

feed-prep-animal.title: Animal row
feed-prep-animal.short: Ticks or unticks this animal for today's defrost list.
feed-prep-animal.more: A female shown as Ovulating or Past ovulation / pre-lay cannot be ticked. That comes from her pairing, not from a setting here.

feed-prep-edit.short: Closes Feed Prep and opens this animal, so you can fill in its feeder profile.
feed-prep-edit.more: Shown only for animals with missing feeder data.

calendar-screen.short: Shows one month of your records on a calendar: breeding appointments, lifecycle stages, care logs, feed due days and quarantine starts and clears.
calendar-screen.more: Nothing on the calendar is stored separately. It is drawn from your animals and pairings, so changing a record changes the calendar. You can save the month as a calendar file or a spreadsheet, and, where it is set up, copy entries into a Google Calendar.

calendar-month.title: Month
calendar-month.short: Moves to the previous or next month with the arrows, or picks a month from the list.

calendar-year.title: Year
calendar-year.short: Moves to the previous or next year with the arrows, or type a year.

calendar-google-connect.short: Opens Google's sign-in so Serpentora may add events to a Google Calendar you choose.
calendar-google-connect.more: Google asks you to allow access to your calendar events. Once allowed, Serpentora reads your name, email address and list of calendars to show here. Nothing is sent to Google until you press a Sync button. The connection lasts until you sign out or reload the page.
calendar-google-connect.words: google calendar connect sign in link

calendar-google-unavailable.short: Says that Google Calendar sync is not set up on this copy of Serpentora, so only the file exports are available.

calendar-google-account.short: Shows the Google account that is connected to the calendar.

calendar-google-sign-out.short: Disconnects Google Calendar: Serpentora gives up its access and forgets the account.
calendar-google-sign-out.more: Events already sent stay in your Google Calendar. Remove them in Google if you no longer want them.

calendar-google-target.short: Picks which of your Google calendars the Sync buttons write into.

calendar-google-sync.short: Sends every entry in the month on screen that passes your filters to the chosen Google calendar, as all-day events.
calendar-google-sync.more: Each event carries the entry's title and details, such as animal names, pairing label, notes and feeder. Each one has a fixed ID, so syncing again is meant to update it rather than add a copy. Deleting a record in Serpentora does not delete the event in Google. The label shows how many events will be sent.

calendar-google-sync-months.title: Sync months
calendar-google-sync-months.short: Sends breeding appointments only, from the month on screen and the four months after it, to the chosen Google calendar.
calendar-google-sync-months.more: Each appointment becomes a three-day all-day event named after the male and the female. Your filters still apply. Deleting a pairing in Serpentora does not delete the events in Google.

calendar-refresh.short: Redraws the month from your current records.
calendar-refresh.more: The calendar already updates when your records change, so you rarely need this.

calendar-export-sheet.short: Saves the breeding appointments in the month on screen as a spreadsheet file (.xlsx).
calendar-export-sheet.more: One row per appointment with start and end dates, male, female, pairing, notes and lock. Your filters apply. The file goes to your downloads; Serpentora does not send it anywhere.
calendar-export-sheet.words: export spreadsheet excel xlsx appointments sheet

calendar-export-month.short: Saves every entry in the month on screen that passes your filters as a calendar file (.ics).
calendar-export-month.more: Most calendar apps, Google Calendar among them, can import an .ics file. The file goes to your downloads; Serpentora does not send it anywhere.

calendar-export-full.short: Saves every entry from your first record to your last, across all months, as one calendar file (.ics).
calendar-export-full.more: Your filters apply. Hover the button to see the date range it covers. The file goes to your downloads.

calendar-upcoming.short: Lists breeding appointments due in the next seven days, so you know which pairs to put together.
calendar-upcoming.more: It looks at the month on screen, so near the end of a month an appointment early next month may not be listed yet.

calendar-filters.title: Filters
calendar-filters.short: Shows or hides each kind of entry: feeds, weights, cleaning, sheds, meds, breeding appointments, clutch actions and quarantine.
calendar-filters.more: Filters also decide what goes into the exports and Google sync.

calendar-grid.title: Month grid
calendar-grid.short: Shows each day of the month with its entries. Today has a blue ring.
calendar-grid.more: Breeding appointments and clutch stages can be pressed to open the pairing. Care logs, feed due days and quarantine entries are for reading.

calendar-pairing-event.title: Breeding appointment
calendar-pairing-event.short: Shows a planned breeding appointment as a male and female over three days. Press it to open the pairing.
calendar-pairing-event.more: Each male has his own colour. When one male has several appointments close together, the calendar spreads them at least three days apart, so an entry can sit a few days from the date you recorded. A lock line appears when a lock was logged.

calendar-clutch-event.title: Clutch stage
calendar-clutch-event.short: Marks a recorded stage of a pairing: ovulation, pre-lay shed, clutch laid or hatch. Press it to open the pairing.

calendar-feed-due.title: Feed due
calendar-feed-due.short: Shows when an animal's next feed is due, from its last accepted feed and the interval in its feeder profile.
calendar-feed-due.more: Refused feeds do not count. An animal with no interval or no feed logged gets no feed due entry.

calendar-legend.title: Male filter
calendar-legend.short: Shows only the appointments and clutch stages of this male. Press it again to show all males.

quarantine-screen.short: Keeps the record of every animal in quarantine: how long it has been there, the checks you logged, test results, and when it was cleared.
quarantine-screen.more: Quarantine records what you see. It does not diagnose anything, and nothing in the app is blocked while an animal is in quarantine. Animals tagged Quarantine appear here. If something concerning shows up, it is always recommended to seek a veterinarian who specialises in reptiles.
tips: Choose New arrival when adding an animal, or set an animal's status to Quarantine, to start a record.
quarantine-screen.words: quarantine new arrival isolation health records

quarantine-notice-open.short: Opens the notice about what quarantine records can and cannot tell you.

quarantine-reference-toggle.short: Shows or hides the reference on what to check, which tests exist and which laboratories take samples.

quarantine-tiles.title: In quarantine, Check due, Awaiting results, Flagged
quarantine-tiles.short: Counts the animals in quarantine, those due a check or a faecal sample, those waiting for a test result, and those with a flag.

quarantine-filter.title: In quarantine, Cleared, All
quarantine-filter.short: Chooses which records to show: animals still in quarantine, animals already cleared, or both.

quarantine-housing.short: Checks where the animals in quarantine are housed in Spaces, and says when one still sits outside the Quarantine room.
quarantine-housing.more: It only reports. Serpentora never moves an animal's record by itself, because the real animal would still be where it was.

quarantine-housing-open-spaces.short: Opens Spaces, where the Quarantine room and its racks are.

quarantine-housing-move.title: Move to
quarantine-housing-move.short: Moves this animal's record to the free tub named on the button, in a rack in the Quarantine room, and empties its old rack tub.
quarantine-housing-move.more: Only the record moves. Move the real animal too, or Spaces will point to the wrong tub. The button appears only when a rack in the Quarantine room has a free tub.

quarantine-card.title: Quarantine card
quarantine-card.short: Shows one animal's quarantine: the day count, a progress bar to the planned length, what is due next, weight change and any flags.
quarantine-card.more: A flag means your latest check was not normal, or a test you logged came back positive. It is flagged, not diagnosed. One sign can have several causes.

quarantine-log-check.short: Opens a short form to log today's check of this animal: weight and what you saw.

quarantine-mark-cleared.short: Opens the clearance list for this animal, before it leaves quarantine.
quarantine-mark-cleared.more: The list shows what is met and what is not. You can still clear the animal; nothing forces you to wait.

quarantine-put-back.short: Puts a cleared animal back into quarantine straight away and tags it Quarantine again.
quarantine-put-back.more: The record keeps its history, and the change is added to it.

quarantine-card-menu.short: Opens more actions for this animal: Open animal, Restart clock and Remove record.

quarantine-restart-clock.short: Starts the quarantine count again from today, after asking why, for example after mites were treated.
quarantine-restart-clock.more: The reason and the restart are added to the history. Cancel in the question leaves the clock as it was.

quarantine-remove-record.short: Deletes this animal's whole quarantine record at once: dates, checks, results and history.
quarantine-remove-record.more: There is no confirmation and no undo. The animal itself stays, with its earlier status back. Use it only for an animal that was tagged by mistake. To end a real quarantine, use Mark cleared instead.

quarantine-check-window.short: Logs one check of the animal. Every answer starts on the normal choice, so a clean check is a single press of Save check.
quarantine-check-window.more: Change only what you saw differently. Press ? next to a question to see how to check it.

quarantine-check-date.short: Sets the day of this check. It starts on today.

quarantine-check-weight.short: Records the animal's weight in grams at this check. Optional.
quarantine-check-weight.more: Weights are compared with the weight at intake to show the change on the card.

quarantine-check-observation.title: Observation buttons
quarantine-check-observation.short: Records what you saw for each part of the check. The first button is the normal answer.
quarantine-check-observation.more: Most other answers show as a flag on the card. Flags come from the latest check, so a later clean check clears them.

quarantine-check-guide.short: Opens the guide for this question: where to look, how to check and what normal looks like.

quarantine-check-notes.short: Adds anything the buttons did not cover.

quarantine-check-save.short: Saves this check to the animal's quarantine record and closes the form.
quarantine-check-save.more: Opened from the Quarantine panel in the animal record, the check is kept only when you press Save changes there.

quarantine-check-cancel.short: Closes the form without saving the check.

quarantine-guide-window.title: Check guide
quarantine-guide-window.short: Explains one check: where to look on the animal, how to do it, and what normal and worth acting on look like.
quarantine-guide-window.more: Drawings are schematic, not photographs. It is reference, not veterinary advice.
quarantine-guide-window.words: guide how to check normal concerning

quarantine-guide-map.title: Snake diagram
quarantine-guide-map.short: Shows the check points on a drawn snake. Press a numbered point to see that check; switch between Whole body and Head.

quarantine-guide-step.title: Previous and next check
quarantine-guide-step.short: Steps to the previous or next check without closing the guide.

quarantine-clearance.title: Clear from quarantine
quarantine-clearance.short: Lists what is usually met before an animal leaves quarantine, ticked or marked for this animal.
quarantine-clearance.more: This list is advice, not a rule. If some items are not met you can clear anyway, and the unmet items are written into the animal's quarantine history.

quarantine-clearance-not-yet.short: Closes the list and keeps the animal in quarantine.

quarantine-clearance-confirm.short: Clears the animal from quarantine today and gives back its earlier status. When everything is met the button reads Mark cleared.
quarantine-clearance-confirm.more: You can undo it with Back into quarantine on the card.

quarantine-notice.short: Says plainly what quarantine records can and cannot do: they record what you see, and might not tell you what it means.
quarantine-notice.more: When an animal starts quarantine, the same notice appears titled Before you start, with Start quarantine to carry on.
quarantine-notice.words: notice vet disclaimer before you start

quarantine-notice-start.short: Closes the notice and adds the new animal with its quarantine record.

quarantine-reference.short: Collects reference for a conversation with a reptile vet: what to check, which tests exist, and laboratories that take samples.
quarantine-reference.more: Reference only. Nothing here is medical advice, and Serpentora does not recommend a test.

quarantine-reference-tabs.title: What to check, Tests, Laboratories
quarantine-reference-tabs.short: Switches the reference between the body check guide, the list of tests and the list of laboratories.

quarantine-reference-test.title: Test
quarantine-reference-test.short: Opens one test to show its method, sample, when it is usually run, its limits and who offers it.

quarantine-reference-lab.title: Laboratory
quarantine-reference-lab.short: Opens this laboratory's own website in a new tab.
quarantine-reference-lab.more: The list is not complete and not an endorsement. Check with the laboratory before sending anything.

quarantine-panel.short: Keeps this animal's quarantine record inside its record: status, dates, intake check, checks, tests, treatments and history.
quarantine-panel.more: Everything you change here is part of the animal record's form. Nothing is kept until you press Save changes, and Cancel throws all of it away together with the other changes in the form. Quarantine is a record only. It records what you observe and does not diagnose anything, and it never blocks pairing, feeding, selling or anything else.
tips: If something concerning shows up, it is always recommended to seek a veterinarian who specialises in reptiles.
quarantine-panel.words: quarantine record isolation new arrival health

quarantine-panel-status-none.short: Removes this animal's whole quarantine record: dates, intake check, checks, tests, treatments and history.
quarantine-panel-status-none.more: It does not ask first. The animal gets back the status it had before quarantine, or Active. Until you press Save changes, Cancel on the animal record brings the old record back, but it also throws away your other changes in the form. After saving there is no undo.
tips: To end a real quarantine, choose Cleared instead. Cleared keeps the record and its history.
quarantine-panel-status-none.words: no quarantine remove wipe never quarantined mistake

quarantine-panel-status-in.short: Starts a quarantine record from today and sets the animal's status to Quarantine.
quarantine-panel-status-in.more: The planned length comes from Where it came from, or 90 days when that is not recorded. For a cleared animal it starts again with today as the new start date, and the change is added to the history. It is kept when you press Save changes on the animal record. Cancel there throws it away.
quarantine-panel-status-in.words: start quarantine in quarantine isolate new arrival

quarantine-panel-status-cleared.short: Ends quarantine today and gives the animal back the status it had before, or Active.
quarantine-panel-status-cleared.more: The record and its history stay. Unlike Mark cleared on the Quarantine screen, this does not show the clearance list first. A Cleared date field appears so you can correct the date. It is kept when you press Save changes on the animal record. Cancel there throws it away.
tips: Pressing Cleared again on a cleared animal sets the cleared date to today.
quarantine-panel-status-cleared.words: clear cleared release end quarantine finished

quarantine-panel-tab-record.short: Shows where the animal came from, the dates, the planned length, the intake check and notes.

quarantine-panel-tab-checks.short: Lists the observation checks logged for this animal, newest first, with Log check to add one.

quarantine-panel-tab-tests.short: Lists the tests and treatments logged for this animal, with buttons to log new ones.

quarantine-panel-tab-history.short: Lists every change to the quarantine with its date: entered, cleared, clock restarted and extended.
quarantine-panel-tab-history.more: The history is written for you when those things happen. It cannot be edited here.

quarantine-panel-source.short: Records where the animal came from and suggests a planned length for it.
quarantine-panel-source.more: The suggestions are 90 days for a known breeder, 120 days for a shop or an expo, and 180 days for an import, a wild-caught animal or an unknown source. Bred here suggests no length. A new suggestion replaces the planned length only while that is still the suggested number, so a length you typed yourself stays.
quarantine-panel-source.words: source origin where from breeder shop expo import wild caught

quarantine-panel-source-name.short: Records who the animal came from, such as a breeder, a shop or a shipment.
quarantine-panel-source-name.words: who from seller breeder shop name

quarantine-panel-started.short: Sets the day quarantine started. The day count and the due date count from it.
quarantine-panel-started.more: Day 1 is the start date itself.

quarantine-panel-planned-days.short: Sets how many days quarantine should last. The due date follows from the start date and this length.
quarantine-panel-planned-days.more: When it is empty, the length suggested for Where it came from is used.
quarantine-panel-planned-days.words: length duration days planned how long

quarantine-panel-cleared-date.short: Sets the day the animal was cleared from quarantine.

quarantine-panel-intake-weight.short: Records the animal's weight in grams when it arrived.
quarantine-panel-intake-weight.more: Later check weights are compared with it, and the clearance list uses it to see whether the animal has lost weight.

quarantine-panel-intake.short: Records what you saw at the first look over the animal on arrival, one line per part of the check.
quarantine-panel-intake.more: Each line is OK, Flag or left unchecked. This records what you observed. It does not tell you what a flag means.

quarantine-panel-what-to-check.short: Opens the check guide at mites, where you can step through every check: where to look and what normal looks like.
quarantine-panel-what-to-check.words: guide how to check what to look for

quarantine-panel-intake-ok.short: Marks this part of the intake check as looking normal.
quarantine-panel-intake-ok.more: Press it again to set the line back to unchecked.

quarantine-panel-intake-flag.short: Marks this part of the intake check as something you noticed and want to keep an eye on.
quarantine-panel-intake-flag.more: Press it again to set the line back to unchecked. A flag records what you saw. It is not a diagnosis.

quarantine-panel-notes.short: Keeps free notes about this quarantine, such as the source, what you observed or treatments.

quarantine-panel-restart-clock.short: Starts the quarantine count again from today, for example after mites were treated.
quarantine-panel-restart-clock.more: It does not ask for a reason here. The history notes that it was restarted from the animal record. It is kept when you press Save changes on the animal record. Cancel there throws it away.
quarantine-panel-restart-clock.words: restart reset clock day count mites treated

quarantine-panel-extend.title: Extend
quarantine-panel-extend.short: Adds 14 or 30 days to the planned length, which moves the due date later.
quarantine-panel-extend.more: Each press adds the days again and writes an entry in the history. It is kept when you press Save changes on the animal record. Cancel there throws it away.
quarantine-panel-extend.words: extend longer more days add days

quarantine-panel-log-check.short: Opens a short form to log a check of this animal: weight and what you saw.
quarantine-panel-log-check.more: Save check in that form adds the check to the record you are editing. It is kept when you press Save changes on the animal record. Cancel there throws it away.

quarantine-panel-check-delete.short: Removes this check from the record.
quarantine-panel-check-delete.more: It does not ask first. Until you press Save changes, Cancel on the animal record brings it back. After saving there is no undo.

quarantine-panel-add-test.short: Opens a small form to log a test, such as a faecal test, with its date, laboratory and result.
quarantine-panel-add-test.more: Serpentora records the test and its result. It does not recommend a test or say what a result means.
tips: Log a test when the sample goes off, as Awaiting result, and set the result when it comes back.
quarantine-panel-add-test.words: test lab faecal sample result log test

quarantine-panel-test-date.short: Sets the day the test was taken or sent.

quarantine-panel-test-kind.short: Chooses which test this is from the list of common reptile tests.

quarantine-panel-test-lab.short: Records the vet or laboratory that ran the test. Optional.

quarantine-panel-test-result.short: Sets the result: Awaiting result, Clear, Positive or Inconclusive.

quarantine-panel-test-save.short: Adds this test to the record and closes the small form.
quarantine-panel-test-save.more: A test with the same date, test and laboratory as one already logged replaces it. If the date is empty, the form closes and nothing is added. It is kept when you press Save changes on the animal record. Cancel there throws it away.

quarantine-panel-test-cancel.short: Closes the small form without adding the test.

quarantine-panel-result-clear.short: Records that this test came back clear, dated today.
quarantine-panel-result-clear.more: The clearance list looks for a clear result in the last 30 days. These buttons show only while a test is awaiting its result. To change a result later, delete the test and log it again.

quarantine-panel-result-positive.short: Records that this test came back positive, dated today.
quarantine-panel-result-positive.more: A positive result shows as a flag on the animal's quarantine card. Serpentora does not say what it means. A reptile vet is the right person to ask. To change a result later, delete the test and log it again.

quarantine-panel-result-inconclusive.short: Records that this test gave no clear answer, dated today.
quarantine-panel-result-inconclusive.more: To change a result later, delete the test and log it again.

quarantine-panel-test-delete.short: Removes this test from the record.
quarantine-panel-test-delete.more: It does not ask first. Until you press Save changes, Cancel on the animal record brings it back. After saving there is no undo.

quarantine-panel-add-treatment.short: Opens a small form to log a treatment: when, what was given, the dose and why.
quarantine-panel-add-treatment.more: The clearance list uses the latest treatment date when mites were seen.

quarantine-panel-treatment-date.short: Sets the day the treatment was given.

quarantine-panel-treatment-what.short: Records what was given. A treatment needs this to be saved.

quarantine-panel-treatment-dose.short: Records the dose, in your own words. Optional.

quarantine-panel-treatment-reason.short: Records why the treatment was given. Optional.

quarantine-panel-treatment-save.short: Adds this treatment to the record and closes the small form.
quarantine-panel-treatment-save.more: If What was given or the date is empty, the form closes and nothing is added. It is kept when you press Save changes on the animal record. Cancel there throws it away.
tips: Treated for mites? Consider Restart clock afterwards.

quarantine-panel-treatment-cancel.short: Closes the small form without adding the treatment.

quarantine-panel-treatment-delete.short: Removes this treatment from the record.
quarantine-panel-treatment-delete.more: It does not ask first. Until you press Save changes, Cancel on the animal record brings it back. After saving there is no undo.

lab-tests-screen.short: Collects your shed tests for a partner laboratory: saved sheds waiting to go, and orders you already sent with their status.
lab-tests-screen.more: Lab tests work through the Serpentora server, so they need a working connection. You start a test from an animal: choose a laboratory, tick the gene tests, then add it to a batch or save it for later. The tests, prices and turnaround all come from the laboratory you choose.
lab-tests-screen.words: lab tests shed test genetic test dna laboratory

lab-past-orders-toggle.short: Shows or hides the list of orders you sent from the saved queue, with their labels.

lab-refresh.short: Loads your saved sheds and sent orders again from the server.
lab-refresh.more: This screen also refreshes by itself every thirty seconds.

lab-sent-orders.short: Lists every shed test order you sent, newest first, with where it stands now.

lab-order-status.title: Order status
lab-order-status.short: Shows the order's status as the server reports it, with a bar of the steps from sent to completed.

lab-cancel-order.short: Cancels an order the laboratory has not received yet, after you confirm with Yes, delete.
lab-cancel-order.more: The cancellation goes through the Serpentora server, and the order and all its data are deleted. It cannot be undone. Once the order has moved past sent, this button is gone.

lab-queue-item.title: Saved shed
lab-queue-item.short: Shows one shed test saved for later. Tick it to include it in the next order.
lab-queue-item.more: Saved sheds are kept on the Serpentora server, so they wait for weeks until you have enough for one box. Ticking is saved straight away.

lab-queue-open-snake.short: Opens the animal this shed came from.

lab-queue-edit-tests.short: Changes which gene tests this shed is saved for, then Save or Cancel.
lab-queue-edit-tests.more: At least one test must stay ticked. The list comes from the laboratory the shed is addressed to.

lab-queue-remove.short: Takes this saved shed out of the queue straight away.
lab-queue-remove.more: There is no confirmation. Nothing has gone to the laboratory yet, so nothing is cancelled there.

lab-queue-priority.short: Marks this shed Routine, Priority or Urgent for the laboratory.

lab-queue-total.title: Order total
lab-queue-total.short: Shows the price the server quotes for the ticked sheds, per shed and for the whole order.
lab-queue-total.more: The figure is the laboratory's own price for these tests, worked out by the server when you tick or untick a shed.

lab-submit-queue.short: Sends the ticked sheds to the laboratory as one order, and downloads the labels for the box.
lab-submit-queue.more: This places a real order with the laboratory through the server. Check the sheds, tests and total first. You can cancel it only while the laboratory has not received it. The label files go to your downloads.

lab-direct-orders.short: Says that on this server every order goes to the laboratory as soon as you create it from an animal, so nothing waits in a queue here.

lab-batch-history.short: Lists the orders you sent from the saved queue, with the date, number of items and total.

lab-download-batch.short: Downloads all the labels for this order again, if you lost or misprinted them.

lab-animal-orders.short: Lists the laboratory orders that include this animal, with their status, tests, labels and certificate.
lab-animal-orders.more: A batch order lists every animal it holds. The panel refreshes by itself every thirty seconds.

lab-order-details.short: Shows or hides the order's details: laboratory, certificate, latest result, findings and lab-confirmed genetics.

lab-preview-labels.short: Opens the order's labels as a PDF in a new tab, to check them before printing.

lab-print-labels.short: Opens a print preview of the shipping label and the sample labels, sized for your label printer.
lab-print-labels.words: print labels sample label shipping label

lab-download-labels.short: Saves the order's labels as a PDF file to your downloads.

lab-certificate-download.short: Saves the laboratory's certificate for this order as a PDF file to your downloads.
lab-certificate-download.more: It appears once the order is completed. In the details, Download PDF does the same.

lab-certificate-view.short: Opens the laboratory's certificate for this order as a PDF in a new tab.

lab-label-preview.short: Shows how the shipping label and the first sample label will print, before you print them.
lab-label-preview.more: Print opens your computer's own print dialog, where you choose the printer. Keep the scale at 100 percent.

lab-label-size.short: Picks the size of your label paper. Serpentora remembers it in this browser for next time.

lab-label-print.short: Opens your computer's print dialog with each label on its own page.

lab-window-close.short: Closes this window without changing anything.

lab-order-window.short: Starts a shed test for this animal: choose a laboratory, tick the gene tests, then add it to the batch or save it for later.
lab-order-window.more: Neither button sends anything to the laboratory yet. The batch is sent with Submit Order in the Batch Order panel, and saved sheds from Lab tests.
lab-order-window.words: order test genetic test shed test

lab-choose-lab.short: Picks the laboratory to send samples to. Its tests, prices and turnaround are the ones shown afterwards.
lab-choose-lab.more: The list shows laboratories that say they test this animal's species, or all of them when the animal has no species. Changing the laboratory clears animals already in the batch, because their tests belong to the old laboratory.

lab-change-lab.short: Opens the laboratory list again to pick a different one.
lab-change-lab.more: Picking a different laboratory clears the batch and the tests ticked here.

lab-test-list.short: Ticks the gene tests you want the laboratory to run on this animal.
lab-test-list.more: The tests come from the chosen laboratory's list for this species.

lab-suggested-tests.short: Suggests tests for genes this animal only possibly carries, such as 66% het, 50% het or possible het, so a lab result can settle them.
lab-suggested-tests.more: Matching tests start ticked. A gene with no matching test in this laboratory's list is shown without a box.

lab-save-for-later.short: Saves this shed with its tests in your queue on the Serpentora server, to send later with others.
lab-save-for-later.more: Nothing goes to the laboratory yet. You send saved sheds from Lab tests.

lab-add-to-batch.short: Adds this animal and its ticked tests to the batch you are about to send. Reads Update in Batch when the animal is already in it.
lab-add-to-batch.more: The batch is kept in this browser until you submit or clear it. Nothing goes to the laboratory until Submit Order.

lab-order-cancel.short: Closes the window without adding or saving anything.

lab-batch-cart.short: Shows the animals waiting in your batch, with the quoted total. Press it to open or close the list.
lab-batch-cart.more: The batch is kept in this browser until you submit or clear it.

lab-batch-remove.short: Takes this animal out of the batch. Nothing is sent or cancelled.

lab-batch-clear.short: Empties the whole batch straight away, without asking.
lab-batch-clear.more: Nothing was sent yet, so nothing is cancelled at the laboratory.

lab-batch-submit.short: Sends the batch to the chosen laboratory as one order, then downloads one label PDF with all the QR codes.
lab-batch-submit.more: This places a real order with the laboratory through the server. Check the animals, the laboratory and the total first. You can cancel it from Lab tests only while the laboratory has not received it. It is grey until a laboratory is chosen and the server is reachable.

lab-batch-retry.short: Tries again to reach the Serpentora server, which batch orders need.

lab-batch-submitted.short: Confirms the order was created and its label PDF is downloading. Press x to dismiss it.

settings-screen.short: Holds your breeder details, ID format, alias lists, exports, appearance, backups, account and language, each on its own tab.
settings-screen.more: Most settings are saved as you change them, like the rest of your records. The version number of Serpentora is shown next to the title.

settings-info.short: Keeps your name, business name, contact details, address and logo, which Serpentora puts on catalogs, labels and PDF headers.
settings-info.more: Each field is saved as you type. The logo is also used for the breeder logo background pattern in Appearance.
settings-info.words: breeder profile business contact address logo

settings-info-name.short: Sets your own name. It is used when no business name is given, and on labels and catalogs.

settings-info-business.short: Sets the name of your business. When filled in, it is shown in place of your own name.

settings-info-email.short: Sets the contact email kept with your breeder details.
settings-info-email.more: This is not the email you sign in with. To change your sign-in email, use Change email in My Account.

settings-info-phone.short: Sets the contact phone number kept with your breeder details.

settings-info-address.title: Address
settings-info-address.short: Sets your street, postal code, city and country.
settings-info-address.more: The address is used as the sender on shipping labels for lab samples.
settings-info-address.words: street postal code zip city country

settings-info-logo.short: Picks an image file to use as your logo. It is shrunk to a sensible size before it is kept.
settings-info-logo.more: A logo with a clear background keeps it, so it looks right on PDF headers. Picking a new file replaces the old logo.

settings-info-save.short: Confirms your breeder info and takes you back to Animals.
settings-info-save.more: The fields are already saved as you type, so this button only shows a confirmation and moves you on.

settings-id-wizard.short: Sets the pattern for the IDs Serpentora creates when you add animals, generate hatchlings or import.
settings-id-wizard.more: Build the pattern from tokens such as the year, the sex, gene codes and a running number. The live preview shows an example ID as you change it. IDs that already exist are not changed.

settings-id-reset.short: Puts the ID pattern and its options back to Serpentora's default.
settings-id-reset.more: It happens at once, without asking. Existing IDs are not changed.

settings-id-template.short: Holds the ID pattern. Type plain text and tokens in square brackets.
settings-id-template.more: The sequence token [SEQ] is required. If you leave it out, it is added at the end for you.
tips: Press a token in Available tokens to add it where the cursor is, or to remove it.

settings-id-padding.short: Sets how many digits the running number has, for example 3 gives 001.

settings-id-uppercase.short: Writes the whole ID in capital letters. Untick it to keep mixed case.

settings-id-free-text.short: Sets the text that appears wherever [TEXT] is in your pattern.

settings-id-preview.short: Shows an example ID from sample values, so you can check the pattern before it is used.
settings-id-preview.more: The sample name, year, sex, sequence and genes here are only for the preview. Nothing is saved to any animal.

settings-id-tokens.short: Lists the tokens you can use. Press one to add it to the pattern, or press it again to take it out.

settings-morph-aliases.short: Maps combo names, such as Pompeii, to the genes they are made of.
settings-morph-aliases.more: Serpentora uses this list to read a combo name as its genes. Your list is saved with your other settings.

settings-morph-alias-import.short: Loads morph aliases from a JSON file and replaces your whole list with them.
settings-morph-alias-import.more: It does not ask first. Use Export JSON before, if you want to keep the current list.

settings-morph-alias-export.short: Downloads your morph aliases as a JSON file.

settings-morph-alias-name.short: The combo name you want Serpentora to recognise, for example Pompeii.

settings-morph-alias-genes.short: The genes the combo is made of, separated by commas.

settings-morph-alias-notes.short: An optional note shown under the alias in the list.

settings-morph-alias-save.short: Adds the alias to the list, or saves your changes when you are editing one.
settings-morph-alias-save.more: An alias name and at least one gene are needed. An alias with the same name is replaced.

settings-alias-edit.short: Puts this row into the fields above so you can change it, then save.

settings-alias-cancel-edit.short: Stops editing and empties the fields. Nothing is changed.

settings-alias-delete.short: Removes this row from the list at once, without asking.
settings-alias-delete.more: In the Gene Alias Manager, a built-in gene goes back to its built-in aliases instead of disappearing. If the morph list ends up empty, Serpentora's default morph list returns.

settings-gene-aliases.short: Lists each gene with the other names and short codes it goes by, such as OD for Orange Dream.
settings-gene-aliases.more: Serpentora uses this list to recognise a gene however it is written. Built-in genes are always in the list; your rows add to them or change their aliases.

settings-gene-alias-import.short: Loads gene aliases from a JSON file and replaces your own rows with them. Built-in genes stay.
settings-gene-alias-import.more: It does not ask first. Use Export JSON before, if you want to keep your current rows.

settings-gene-alias-export.short: Downloads the gene alias list as a JSON file.

settings-gene-alias-name.short: The gene's main name, for example Orange Dream.

settings-gene-alias-aliases.short: Other ways the gene is written, separated by commas.

settings-gene-alias-shorthand.short: Short codes for the gene, separated by commas, for example OD.

settings-gene-alias-save.short: Adds the gene to the list, or saves your changes when you are editing one.
settings-gene-alias-save.more: A gene name is needed. A row with the same gene name is replaced.

settings-appearance.short: Changes how Serpentora looks: colour preset, material, light or dark mode, colours, type, spacing and motion.
settings-appearance.more: The preview at the top shows each change as you make it. Changes apply straight away and are saved.
settings-appearance.words: theme colours look skin dark mode style

settings-appearance-preview.short: Shows a sample card and list in your current look, so you can see a change before you look elsewhere.
settings-appearance-preview.more: The buttons in the preview are samples and do nothing.

settings-appearance-reset.short: Puts every appearance setting back to the default look.
settings-appearance-reset.more: It happens at once, without asking. Presets you saved yourself are kept.

settings-appearance-preset.more: The four dots show the preset's background, surface, primary and accent colours. You can fine tune colours and type afterwards.

settings-appearance-material.short: Sets the texture and depth of cards and panels, separate from the colours.
settings-appearance-material.more: Only materials that suit the current preset are listed.

settings-appearance-save-preset.short: Saves your current colours and type as a preset with the name you type.
settings-appearance-save-preset.more: Saved presets are kept in this browser.

settings-appearance-high-contrast.short: Switches to the high contrast preset, with larger type, more line spacing and reduced motion.
settings-appearance-high-contrast.more: Turning it off returns to the default preset with medium type and animations on.

settings-appearance-theme-mode.short: Chooses light, dark, or whatever your device is set to.

settings-appearance-background.short: Chooses a plain background or a pattern made from your breeder logo.
settings-appearance-background.more: The pattern needs a logo uploaded in Breeder info.

settings-appearance-colour.title: Colours
settings-appearance-colour.short: Changes one colour of the current preset. Pick it, or type a hex code.
settings-appearance-colour.more: A colour that would make text or button labels hard to read is refused, and a note says why.

settings-appearance-colour-reset.short: Removes your colour changes and goes back to the preset's own colours.

settings-appearance-typography.short: Sets the font, the base text size and the line spacing.

settings-appearance-density.short: Sets how tightly lists and cards are packed.

settings-appearance-corners.short: Sets how rounded the corners of cards and buttons are.

settings-appearance-motion.short: Turns small animations on or off. Prefer reduced motion also turns animations off.

settings-language.short: Chooses the language of Serpentora's screens.
settings-language.more: Help texts are in English for now. Names you type yourself, such as animal names, are not translated.

settings-language-option.short: Switches Serpentora to this language straight away.

settings-dev-tools.title: Developer Tools
settings-dev-tools.short: Holds actions for testing Serpentora. This tab exists only in development builds.

settings-return-to-defaults.title: Return to Defaults
settings-return-to-defaults.short: Erases everything Serpentora keeps in this browser and starts again with the example collection.
settings-return-to-defaults.more: It asks you to confirm first. It clears this browser's storage, including the backup vault, and then reloads. It cannot be undone, so download a backup first if you want to keep anything.

app-dialog.title: Message
app-dialog.short: Shows a message from Serpentora, asks you to confirm an action, or asks you to type a value.
app-dialog.more: Read the text before you press a button. When it asks to confirm, nothing happens until you press the confirm button.

app-dialog-input.title: Text field
app-dialog-input.short: Holds the value the message asks for, such as a name. Change it, then confirm.

app-dialog-confirm.title: Confirm
app-dialog-confirm.short: Goes ahead with what the window describes.
app-dialog-confirm.more: Its label says what it does, such as OK, Save or Delete. Read the window first: some actions cannot be undone.

app-dialog-cancel.short: Closes the window without doing anything.

app-dialog-close.short: Closes this window. Anything you have not saved in it is not kept.

app-dialog-choice.title: Option
app-dialog-choice.short: Picks this option. The text under it says what it does.

export-screen.short: Downloads your animals and pairings as PDF, spreadsheet, CSV, a catalog or plain text, and sets up label sizes.
export-screen.more: Exports are files made from the records in Serpentora. Making one changes nothing in your records.
export-screen.words: export download pdf spreadsheet excel csv catalog labels

export-lab-label-size.short: Sets the label size used for lab sample QR labels and shipping labels.
export-lab-label-size.more: Choose a preset or type a width and height, then press Save. The two previews show how a label will look at that size.
export-lab-label-size.words: label size shed test sample shipping

export-lab-label-preset.title: Label size presets
export-lab-label-preset.short: Fills in the width and height of a common label size. Press Save to use it.

export-lab-label-dimensions.title: Label width and height
export-lab-label-dimensions.short: Sets the label width and height in millimetres. Press Save to use them.
export-lab-label-dimensions.more: A note shows when a size is outside the allowed range.

export-lab-label-save.short: Makes the width and height above the size used for lab labels.

export-lab-label-reset.short: Puts the lab label size back to the default at once.

export-lab-label-guides.short: Draws layout guide lines on the previews and on the labels Serpentora makes. Use it to check alignment.

export-pdf-labels.short: Sets the label layout for QR label PDFs: thermal labels, sheet labels or a custom size.
export-pdf-labels.more: The note below the choices shows the label and page size that will be used.
export-pdf-labels.words: pdf labels thermal sheet avery qr

export-pdf-label-format.short: Chooses thermal labels, sheet labels or a custom size.

export-pdf-label-preset.short: Chooses the brand, category and size of your label stock.

export-pdf-label-custom.title: Custom label size
export-pdf-label-custom.short: Sets the unit, width and height of a custom label.

export-animals-pdf.short: Downloads the animals chosen under Which animals as a PDF table, with the fields you ticked.

export-animals-sheet.short: Downloads the animals chosen under Which animals as a spreadsheet (.xlsx), with the fields you ticked.

export-catalog.short: Makes a PDF catalog with one page per animal, with photo, genetics and parents, and your breeder details.
export-catalog.more: It uses the animals chosen under Which animals. With Catalog: only animals marked for sale ticked, animals not marked for sale are left out.

export-catalog-for-sale.short: Leaves animals that are not marked for sale out of the catalog. Other exports are not affected.

export-text-list.short: Opens the chosen animals as plain text, grouped by birth year, ready to copy into a message.

export-text-list-window.short: Shows the animal list as plain text. Copy it, or download it as a .txt file.

export-text-list-copy.short: Copies the whole list to the clipboard.
export-text-list-copy.more: If copying is not allowed in this browser, a note says so. Select the text and copy it by hand instead.

export-text-list-download.short: Saves the list as a .txt file.

export-scope.short: Chooses which animals go into the animal exports, the catalog and the text list.
export-scope.more: First choose to start from all animals, from groups or from tags. Then untick any animal you want to hold back. The line below counts how many animals will be exported.

export-scope-start.title: Start from
export-scope-start.short: Starts the selection from all animals, from chosen groups, or from chosen tags.

export-scope-filter.title: Group or tag
export-scope-filter.short: Includes the animals in this group or with this tag.

export-scope-select.title: Select all and Select none
export-scope-select.short: Ticks or unticks every animal shown in the list below.
export-scope-select.more: Animals hidden by the search are not changed.

export-scope-search.short: Finds an animal in the list by name or ID. It only hides rows; hidden animals stay in the export.

export-scope-animal.title: Animal in the selection
export-scope-animal.short: Untick an animal to leave it out of the export.

export-scope-reset.short: Clears the selection, so every animal is exported again.

export-field.title: Export fields
export-field.short: Ticks or unticks a column for the PDF and spreadsheet exports.
export-field.more: At least one field always stays ticked.

export-fields-select-all.short: Ticks every field in this list.

export-fields-reset.short: Goes back to the default set of fields.

export-pairings-pdf.short: Downloads your pairings as a PDF table, in the layout chosen below.

export-pairings-sheet.short: Downloads your pairings as a spreadsheet (.xlsx), in the layout chosen below.

export-pairings-csv.short: Downloads your pairings as a CSV file, in the layout chosen below.

export-pairings-layout.short: Chooses one row per pairing (Default) or one row per male with his females (By pairing).
export-pairings-layout.more: The field ticks only apply to the Default layout. By pairing has its own season and status filters.

export-pairings-season.short: Limits the By pairing export to one season.

export-pairings-status.short: Limits the By pairing export to pairings with the statuses you pick. Clear statuses removes the limit.

export-pairings-unpaired.short: Adds males that have no pairing as rows of their own in the By pairing export.

backup-screen.short: Keeps copies of your data safe: backup files, the backup vault, automatic backups, cloud sync and restore.
backup-screen.more: Your changes are saved in this browser as you go, and sent to your Serpentora account while you are signed in. Backups are extra copies you control.
backup-screen.words: backup restore sync cloud vault safety

backup-compress-photos.short: Shrinks the photos already stored on your animals, once, so they take less space.
backup-compress-photos.more: It asks you to confirm first and says how many photos it will change. The originals are replaced, and this cannot be undone, so download a backup first if you want them kept. While you are signed in, the animals whose photos changed are sent to your account again. New photos are already shrunk as you add them.

backup-compress-stop.short: Stops the compression after the photo it is working on. Photos already done stay compressed.

backup-download.title: Download backup
backup-download.short: Downloads a backup file (.bpbackup) with your animals, pairings, groups, breeder info, alias lists and spaces.
backup-download.more: Keep the file somewhere safe. You can bring it back with Choose backup file.
backup-download.words: backup download file save copy export

backup-save-to-vault.short: Saves a copy of your data as a named backup in the backup vault below.
backup-save-to-vault.more: It asks for a name first. The vault is kept in this browser, so it is not a copy on another device.

backup-schedule.short: Sets how often Serpentora saves an automatic backup into the vault: off, every night, every week or every month.
backup-schedule.more: Automatic backups only run while Serpentora is open in your browser. When it is opened after the time has passed, a backup is made then.

backup-run-now.short: Makes an automatic backup now and adds it to the vault.

backup-download-snapshot.short: Downloads the most recent automatic backup as a file.

backup-retention.short: Sets how many backups the vault keeps.
backup-retention.more: When a new backup is saved and the vault is over the limit, the oldest backups are removed.

backup-vault.short: Lists the backups saved in this browser, by hand or automatically, with their date and size.
backup-vault.more: Each one can be downloaded, restored, renamed or deleted.

backup-vault-download.short: Downloads this backup as a file.

backup-vault-restore.short: Replaces your animals, pairings and groups with the ones in this backup, together with its breeder info, aliases and spaces.
backup-vault-restore.more: It does not ask first, and what you had before is not kept, so download a backup first. While you are signed in, the restored records are compared with your account at the next sync, so records that exist in your account but not in the backup can come back.

backup-vault-rename.short: Gives this backup a new name.

backup-vault-delete.short: Deletes this backup from the vault.
backup-vault-delete.more: It asks you to confirm first. It cannot be undone.

backup-restore-file.short: Picks a .bpbackup file and replaces your data in this browser with its contents.
backup-restore-file.more: It does not ask first, and what you had before is not kept, so download a backup first. The file must hold at least one animal or pairing. While you are signed in, the restored records are compared with your account at the next sync.

backup-import-legacy.short: Picks a .json export from an older version of the app and replaces your data with it.
backup-import-legacy.more: It works like Choose backup file: it does not ask first, and what you had before is not kept.

sync-now.short: Runs the exchange with your Serpentora account now: newer records from either side are merged and saved to both.
sync-now.more: This also happens shortly after each change while you are signed in, and when Serpentora opens. Use it to fetch changes made on another device. It needs you to be signed in and connected.

sync-status.short: Shows the connection to your account, whether you are signed in, and when the last cloud sync was.
sync-status.more: Ready to sync counts the animals and pairings in this browser. Latest status repeats the last sync message.

sync-connection-status.title: Connection status
sync-connection-status.short: Shows whether Serpentora can reach your account right now.
sync-connection-status.more: Green means connected. Amber means it cannot reach your account or you need to sign in again. A second line appears when the last cloud save failed, with the reason.

sync-not-synced.short: Appears when sending your changes to your account failed. Press it to open Backups.
sync-not-synced.more: Your changes are still saved in this browser. The note stays until a later save succeeds. Hold the pointer over it to see the reason.

sync-not-synced-toast.short: Says, once, that sending your changes to your account failed, and why.
sync-not-synced-toast.more: It closes by itself after a few seconds. Your changes are still saved in this browser.

sync-toast-close.short: Closes this notice. The Not synced note at the top stays.

sync-backend-banner.title: Connected to shared backend
sync-backend-banner.short: Shows whether this copy of the app can reach the Serpentora server and whether your session there is accepted.
sync-backend-banner.more: This bar appears only in a development build of the app. The published app does not show it; the connection status in Settings is its equivalent. The other states it can show are Checking shared backend, Backend unreachable, Backend configuration error and Unauthorized session.

sync-backend-retry.title: Retry
sync-backend-retry.short: Checks the connection to the server again and updates the bar.
sync-backend-retry.more: It asks the server whether it is up and, if you are signed in, whether your session is still accepted. It does not send or fetch your records. If the server no longer accepts your session, the sign in saved in this browser is removed and you need to sign in again.

sync-backend-diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
sync-backend-diagnostics.short: Shows or hides the details behind the bar: whether the server address is set, whether it was reachable, the sign in status and when it was last checked.
sync-backend-diagnostics.more: The details are for finding a setup problem. They change nothing.

account-screen.short: Shows the Serpentora account you are signed in with, its plan and features, and lets you change your email or password, download your data or delete the account.

account-refresh.short: Loads your account details, plan and feature access again from the server.

account-login-info.short: Shows the email you sign in with, whether it is verified, your name, role and user ID.
account-login-info.more: If you asked to change your email, the new address is shown as waiting for confirmation.

account-sign-out-device.short: Removes the sign-in from this browser, so your changes stop being sent to your account.
account-sign-out-device.more: Your records in this browser are not deleted. Reload or sign in again to reconnect.

account-backend.short: Shows whether this browser is connected and signed in to your account, and whether cloud sync is ready.

account-features.short: Shows which features your current plan includes, and how much of a limit you have used.
account-features.more: Limited means your plan does not include that feature, or its limit is reached.

account-plans.short: Lists Serpentora's plans and marks your current one. Paid plans cannot be bought yet.
account-plans.more: Where a paid plan says Not purchasable yet, its button is switched off. Some setups show a Stripe test page instead; it takes test cards only and no real money is involved.

account-change-plan.short: Moves your account to this plan, after you confirm. Paid plans cannot be bought yet.
account-change-plan.more: A free plan changes at once and its limits apply straight away. A paid plan shows Not purchasable yet and cannot be chosen. Where a Stripe test page opens instead, no real card is used and nothing is taken.

account-dismiss-notice.short: Hides this notice about returning from the Stripe page.

account-change-email.short: Changes the email you sign in with. Type the new address and your current password, then press Change email.
account-change-email.more: A confirmation link is emailed to the new address. Your current email stays active until you open that link.

account-change-password.short: Changes your password. Type your current password and the new one twice, then press Change password.
account-change-password.more: A confirmation is emailed to you once it has changed.

account-download-data.short: Downloads what your Serpentora account holds about you as a JSON file, all of it or only the parts you tick.
account-download-data.more: It comes from the server, not from this browser. A file with only some parts is marked as partial. For a file you can restore into Serpentora, use Download backup instead.

account-export-groups.title: Data categories
account-export-groups.short: Chooses which categories go into Download my data. Account and profile is always included.

account-delete.short: Schedules your account and every record in it for permanent deletion. Type your password and DELETE, then confirm.
account-delete.more: Animals, pairings, clutches, photos, notes, lab orders and messages are all erased. You have a grace period, shown on screen, to change your mind with Keep my account or by signing back in. After that it cannot be undone. Download your data first if you want a copy.

account-keep.short: Cancels the scheduled deletion, so your account and records stay.

account-signed-in-chip.title: Signed in as
account-signed-in-chip.short: Shows the name of the account you are signed in with.

account-sign-out.short: Signs you out and returns to the sign-in screen.
account-sign-out.more: Your records in this browser are not deleted. While you are signed out, changes are not sent to your account.

account-animal-limit.title: Animal limit
account-animal-limit.short: Says how many animals your plan holds, and stops an add or import that would go over it.
account-animal-limit.more: Skip some rows of an import, or remove animals, to stay within the limit.

account-locked-feature.title: Not included in your plan
account-locked-feature.short: Says that your current plan does not include this feature, before you try it.

account-see-plans.short: Opens My Account in Settings, where the plans are listed.
